verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: קַדֶּשׁ־ לִ֨י כָל־ בְּכ֜וֹר פֶּ֤טֶר כָּל־ רֶ֙חֶם֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֖י הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: qad·deš- lî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr pe·ṭer kāl- re·ḥem biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh lî hū
verses.literal: Consecrate to Me every firstborn male The firstborn from every womb among the Israelites . . . belongs to Me both of man and beast

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם זָכ֞וֹר אֶת־ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצָאתֶ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד הוֹצִ֧יא יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל חָמֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- hā·‘ām zā·ḵō·wr ’eṯ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’ă·šer yə·ṣā·ṯem mim·miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm kî bə·ḥō·zeq yāḏ hō·w·ṣî Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem miz·zeh wə·lō yê·’ā·ḵêl ḥā·mêṣ
verses.literal: So Moses told . . . the people Remember this day the day you came out of Egypt out of the house of slavery for the LORD brought you out of it by the strength of His hand And nothing leavened shall be eaten

verses.original: הַיּ֖וֹם אַתֶּ֣ם יֹצְאִ֑ים בְּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הָאָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm ’at·tem yō·ṣə·’îm bə·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Today in the month of Abib you are leaving

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כִֽי־ יְבִֽיאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֡ה אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ֠כְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֣תֶת לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ וְעָבַדְתָּ֛ אֶת־ הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵî- yə·ḇî·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’el- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lā·ṯeṯ lāḵ ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh haz·zōṯ ba·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh
verses.literal: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites Hittites Amorites Hivites and Jebusites the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you a land flowing with milk and honey you shall keep this service in this month

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצֹּ֑ת וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י חַ֖ג לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣōṯ ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ḥaḡ Yah·weh
verses.literal: For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the LORD

verses.original: מַצּוֹת֙ יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֜ חָמֵ֗ץ וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָאֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ שְׂאֹ֖ר בְּכָל־ גְּבֻלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·ṣō·wṯ yê·’ā·ḵêl ’êṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm wə·lō- yê·rā·’eh lə·ḵā ḥā·mêṣ wə·lō- yê·rā·’eh lə·ḵā śə·’ōr bə·ḵāl gə·ḇu·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Unleavened bread shall be eaten during those seven days Nothing leavened may be found among you nor shall leaven be found anywhere within your borders

verses.original: וְהִגַּדְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּעֲב֣וּר זֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִ֔י בְּצֵאתִ֖י מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hig·gaḏ·tā lə·ḇin·ḵā bay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mōr ba·‘ă·ḇūr zeh ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh lî bə·ṣê·ṯî mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And on that . . . day you are to explain to your son This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ לְךָ֨ לְא֜וֹת עַל־ יָדְךָ֗ וּלְזִכָּרוֹן֙ בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן תִּהְיֶ֛ה תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה בְּפִ֑יךָ כִּ֚י בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה הוֹצִֽאֲךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·ḵā lə·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yā·ḏə·ḵā ū·lə·zik·kā·rō·wn bên ‘ê·ne·ḵā lə·ma·‘an tih·yeh tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh bə·p̄î·ḵā kî bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh hō·w·ṣi·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: It shall be a sign for you on your hand and a reminder on your forehead . . . that the Law of the LORD is to be on your lips For with a mighty hand the LORD brought you out of Egypt

verses.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־ הַחֻקָּ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְמוֹעֲדָ֑הּ מִיָּמִ֖ים יָמִֽימָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mar·tā ’eṯ- ha·ḥuq·qāh haz·zōṯ lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏāh mî·yā·mîm yā·mî·māh
verses.literal: Therefore you shall keep this statute at the appointed time year after year

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ יְבִֽאֲךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְךָ֖ וְלַֽאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וּנְתָנָ֖הּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yə·ḇi·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’el- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘ lə·ḵā wə·la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā ū·nə·ṯā·nāh lāḵ
verses.literal: And after the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you as He swore to you and your fathers

verses.original: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ֥ כָל־ פֶּֽטֶר־ רֶ֖חֶם לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְכָל־ פֶּ֣טֶר׀ שֶׁ֣גֶר בְּהֵמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ הַזְּכָרִ֖ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tā ḵāl pe·ṭer- re·ḥem Yah·weh wə·ḵāl pe·ṭer še·ḡer bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer yih·yeh lə·ḵā haz·zə·ḵā·rîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: you are to present to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb All the firstborn . . . males of your . . . livestock belong to the LORD

verses.original: וְכָל־ פֶּ֤טֶר חֲמֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֨ל בְּכ֥וֹר אָדָ֛ם בְּבָנֶ֖יךָ תִּפְדֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl pe·ṭer ḥă·mōr tip̄·deh ḇə·śeh wə·’im- lō ṯip̄·deh wa·‘ă·rap̄·tōw wə·ḵōl bə·ḵō·wr ’ā·ḏām bə·ḇā·ne·ḵā tip̄·deh
verses.literal: You must redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb and if you do not redeem it you are to break its neck And every firstborn . . . of your sons you must redeem

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ בִנְךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֣ר מַה־ זֹּ֑את וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֗ד הוֹצִיאָ֧נוּ יְהוָ֛ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yiš·’ā·lə·ḵā ḇin·ḵā mā·ḥār lê·mōr mah- zōṯ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw bə·ḥō·zeq yāḏ hō·w·ṣî·’ā·nū Yah·weh mim·miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: In the future when your son asks you What does this mean you are to tell him With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt out of the house of slavery

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּֽי־ הִקְשָׁ֣ה פַרְעֹה֮ לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ֒ וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג יְהֹוָ֤ה כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִבְּכֹ֥ר אָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּהֵמָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֩ אֲנִ֨י זֹבֵ֜חַ לַֽיהוָ֗ה כָּל־ פֶּ֤טֶר רֶ֙חֶם֙ הַזְּכָרִ֔ים וְכָל־ בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנַ֖י אֶפְדֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- hiq·šāh p̄ar·‘ōh lə·šal·lə·ḥê·nū way·ya·hă·rōḡ Yah·weh kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bə·ḵōr ’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·ḵō·wr bə·hê·māh ‘al- kên ’ă·nî zō·ḇê·aḥ Yah·weh kāl- pe·ṭer re·ḥem haz·zə·ḵā·rîm wə·ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bā·nay ’ep̄·deh
verses.literal: And when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go the LORD killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt both of man and beast This is why . . . I sacrifice to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְאוֹת֙ עַל־ יָ֣דְכָ֔ה וּלְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֑יךָ כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד הוֹצִיאָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yā·ḏə·ḵāh ū·lə·ṭō·w·ṭā·p̄ōṯ bên ‘ê·ne·ḵā kî bə·ḥō·zeq yāḏ hō·w·ṣî·’ā·nū Yah·weh mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead . . . for with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּשַׁלַּ֣ח פַּרְעֹה֮ אֶת־ הָעָם֒ וְלֹא־ נָחָ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים דֶּ֚רֶךְ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כִּ֥י קָר֖וֹב ה֑וּא כִּ֣י׀ אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים פֶּֽן־ יִנָּחֵ֥ם הָעָ֛ם בִּרְאֹתָ֥ם מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְשָׁ֥בוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·šal·laḥ par·‘ōh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·lō- nā·ḥām ’ĕ·lō·hîm de·reḵ ’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm kî qā·rō·wḇ hū kî ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm pen- yin·nā·ḥêm hā·‘ām bir·’ō·ṯām mil·ḥā·māh wə·šā·ḇū miṣ·rā·yə·māh
verses.literal: When Pharaoh let the people go God did not lead them along the road through the land of the Philistines though it was shorter For God . . . said If the people face war they might change their minds and return to Egypt

verses.original: וַיַּסֵּ֨ב אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ אֶת־ הָעָ֛ם דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר יַם־ ס֑וּף וַחֲמֻשִׁ֛ים עָל֥וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·sêḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·‘ām de·reḵ ham·miḏ·bār yam- sūp̄ wa·ḥă·mu·šîm ‘ā·lū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So God led the people around by the way of the wilderness toward the Red Sea And the Israelites . . . left the land of Egypt arrayed for battle

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹסֵ֖ף עִמּ֑וֹ כִּי֩ הַשְׁבֵּ֨עַ הִשְׁבִּ֜יעַ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֧ם אֶת־ עַצְמֹתַ֛י מִזֶּ֖ה אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ‘im·mōw kî haš·bê·a‘ hiš·bî·a‘ ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr pā·qōḏ yip̄·qōḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ·ḵem wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯem ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·ṯay miz·zeh ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear a solemn oath . . . when he said God will surely attend to . . . you and then you must carry my bones with you from this place

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם בִּקְצֵ֖ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mis·suk·kōṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·’ê·ṯām biq·ṣêh ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֡ה הֹלֵךְ֩ לִפְנֵיהֶ֨ם יוֹמָ֜ם בְּעַמּ֤וּד עָנָן֙ לַנְחֹתָ֣ם הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְלַ֛יְלָה בְּעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֑ם לָלֶ֖כֶת יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·hem yō·w·mām bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān lan·ḥō·ṯām had·de·reḵ wə·lay·lāh bə·‘am·mūḏ ’êš lə·hā·’îr lā·hem lā·le·ḵeṯ yō·w·mām wā·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day and in a pillar of fire to give them light . . . by night so that they could travel by day or night

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָמִ֞ישׁ עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַמּ֥וּד הָאֵ֖שׁ לָ֑יְלָה לִפְנֵ֖י הָעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·mîš ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān yō·w·mām wə·‘am·mūḏ hā·’êš lā·yə·lāh lip̄·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people
